'''Meeka Reen's pirates''' were a group of pirates fighting against the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Jerne]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. The pirates were led by the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Meeka Reen]], who did not ally her pirates with the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]].
